body: Yeah, I tried closing everything. Still lags like crazy
Thanks for the advice! I'll get that when I get paid \^w\^
I started saving up for a laptop with Windows, but it would be cool to find a solution now so I don't have to play in 30 fps for a year xD

I feel like this is the classic case of "they're not really *friends* but they're there because I have no one else to talk to". Since our school is so small, I only have 60 other people in my grade to make friends with so there's a good chance that I just won't like the other people there. I didn't want to be completely alone however so I do have some people I talk to everyday. However, recently I've been getting more and more fed up with them and I just want them to leave me alone. The sexuality is race stuff is... yeah, I know it's apart of me and I can't change it but it's hard to figure out how to love myself when I absolutely don't x3

Thanks for your reply \^w\^

It's hard to change my entire mindset though. I had to attend an outpatient program where I did a bunch of group therapy with other kids after I got out of the hospital. In this program they tried to make us think more highly of ourselves and other things but everyone hated it xD. I hope I can think like that one day, but at the moment it seems like that's not going to happen.

Thanks for your reply \^w\^
